title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 4 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: How important is bread in your culture?
Have you tried any kinds of bread from other countries?
Would you be interested in learning how to make bread?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a person you know who is very competitive.
cue_card_bullets: what this person is competitive about
and explain why you think this person is so competitive

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What kinds of competitions do people like to enter in your country?
What do you think is the best kind of prize to win in a competition?
Why do people like watching quiz shows and other competitions on TV?
How important is it to be very competitive at sport?
Do you think sportspeople perform better when they play against competitors who are stronger than they are?
Why do some people think that taking part in sport is more important than winning?
